name: @wellsfargo-starui/data
description: SharedWorker-backed data services for StarGrid DataPort. Consolidates host-data (host-data-angular stays excluded from the pipeline).

scripts.build: rimraf host-data/dist host-data/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && tsc --project host-data/tsconfig.json && node host-data/scripts/buildWorker.mjs && node host-data/scripts/copy-assets.mjs

//dependencies-registry-notes: @perspective-dev/client pinned to 4.5.2 (not latest): every invariant recorded in host-data/src/runtime/perspective/*.ts and in the window-side row engine (packages/react-grid/perspective-grid/src — view-lifecycle crashes, expression-language quirks, schema-coercion behaviour) was measured against 4.5.2 specifically. The two packages must move together, and only after re-running that measurement pass against the new version.
